illustration.appliesTo: V1.1 彩绘玻璃 theme redraws of the card illustrations: controllers C*, consumables I*, services O*, dice upgrades U* (P0Config ids), and boss emblems and loot art. Each redraw keeps the subject of the default illustration of the same id.

output.instruction: True transparent alpha background with no backdrop of any colour and no background shapes. A single finished illustration, not a sheet of variants.

illustration.displaySizesNote: Same on-screen sizes as the default illustrations (shop card at 1440p / 1080p / 720p, and a compact slot).
illustration.plateRole: STYLE PLATE: four card illustrations in the stained-glass style of this game, cropped from concept art and still standing on their radiating amber and violet glass-pane backdrop. Copy their rendering exactly (objects built from coloured glass pieces held by even dark lead lines, backlit glow inside each piece, grisaille shading, jewel tones, marble-white dice with ruby or cobalt pips). Do not copy their subjects, their layout or the radiating pane backdrop.
illustration.styleBlock: Match the STYLE PLATE (reference image 1) exactly: Gothic stained-glass window illustration. Every object is built from pieces of coloured glass held together by dark lead came lines of even weight; each glass piece glows softly as if lit from behind, with subtle hand-painted grisaille shading near its edges; jewel tones; clear, bold shapes. Dice are pale marble-white glass cubes with ruby-red or cobalt-blue jewel pips, outlined in lead. Three-quarter view from slightly above.
illustration.colorRoles: Marble white #F1EBE1 for dice bodies and pale glass; ruby #BB210D for red pips and red glass; cobalt #0643A0 with sky blue #31A6EF for blue pips, water and blue glass; amber #F8C761 with deep amber #E89D1B for gold, brass and warm light; violet #7A55A8 sparingly for a secondary accent; lead #0F0E12 for every outline. No other hues, no neon.
illustration.composition: One cohesive subject group of at most three objects, centred on a square canvas; the subject spans roughly 70 to 95 percent of the canvas width without touching the edges, with even transparent margin on every side; the silhouette must stay readable at 64 pixels. Two or three short glass-shard strokes are allowed when they express the effect. The card frame of the game draws its own backdrop, so the illustration has no background field at all.
illustration.avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, prices, card frames, UI elements, a background window, radiating backdrop panes, arch frames, ground scenery, checkerboard, photorealism, 3D-render look, pixel art, neon glow, grunge, human characters, saints or religious figures, expressive faces.
